items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: I knew Dude, but I knew him.

ctx.x: He was a musician. I remember somebody. I remember somebody. I remember Buddy Petit. I sure do.

What did he do? He was a musician. I was trying to think of the other man. He used to come here. He died. Foster. You know Foster? Had two brothers, Dude and... I know Dude. You know Dude? Dude and Foster. Yeah. You know that? I knew Dude, but I knew him. See, I came down in the Navy in 1945.
Well, Foster wasn't dead then, was he? I never knew him. He may have been dead. I knew him alive. I just knew Dude then, you know?
